{{Top|leg}}
The '''warfare upgrade''' was a highly complex module that was designed as an alternative to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] training. This module allowed droids to learn at an extremely fast rate so that master generals, tacticians, and assassins were created after only a short install time.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
Although intended to be used by HK-47, this item can be given to G0-T0 or T3-M4, giving it to them allows them to use blaster rifles and carbines. It can cause a few graphical errors when equipping or during combat, however.
